run_switch_constraint_solver: run the pybullet example that switches constraint solvers between LCP PGS and Dantzig
run_pybullet_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation with stacked cubes and gravity using the Dantzig solver
run_physics_engine_config: run a pybullet simulation that configures solver iterations and residual threshold parameters
run_load_urdf_stack: run a pybullet script that loads a plane and stacks 10 small cubes vertically
run_change_dynamics: run a pybullet simulation that changes the mass dynamics of the top cube in a stack
